summary: The St. Joe Company filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 results and declaring a quarterly dividend of $0.16 per share, payable September 18, 2026. Net income rose 37% to $40.5 million and revenue rose 23% to $158.8 million. The company repurchased $32.7 million of stock and paid $9.1 million in dividends. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is present; this is a routine earnings and dividend announcement.
